questions.q: What did Kotick shout at Sea Vitch until the gulls joined in and the walrus finally answered him?
choices: Sleepy-head
Fish-thief
Clam-eater
Old tusker

questions.q: Who did Sea Vitch tell Kotick to go and ask about a place where men never come?
choices: The old albatross of Kerguelen
Sea Cow, if he was still living
Limmershin, the little Winter Wren
The Burgomaster gulls on the islet

questions.q: Why did the seals at Novastoshnah not understand why Kotick was so upset?
choices: None of them had seen the killing for themselves
They were jealous that Kotick was the only white seal
They thought Kotick had made up the whole story
They were too busy fighting for places on the beach
questions.evidence: none of the other seals had seen the killing

questions.q: Even when Kotick found an island with a good hard beach, why would he not stay there?
choices: The fishing nearby was too poor to feed a large herd of seals
The island was too far from Novastoshnah for the seals to swim
Sharks and killer whales lived in the waters all around it
He could tell men had come there before and would come again
questions.evidence: where men had come once they would come again

questions.q: What story did the dying old seal on the island of green trees tell Kotick?
choices: That Sea Cow lived in a warm sea far to the south of the Horn
That a white seal would one day lead the seals to a quiet place
That men had promised never to visit the Lost Rookery again
That a great whale would one day carry the seals to safety
questions.evidence: some day a white seal would come out of the North and lead the seal people to a quiet place

questions.q: Kotick "set off alone because of a notion in his bullet-head." What does "notion" mean here?
choices: A pain
A dream he had while sleeping
An idea
A bump from fighting
questions.evidence: because of a notion in his bullet-head

questions.q: When Matkah begged him to marry and settle down, what did Kotick mean by "it is always the seventh wave that goes farthest up the beach"?
choices: He wanted to wait for calmer seas before leaving
One more try might be the one that finally works
He would marry after seven more years of travel
The best beaches are always the farthest away
questions.evidence: it is always the seventh wave that goes farthest up the beach

questions.q: Why did Kotick swim westward on his last exploration?
choices: An albatross had told him of an island to the west
He was chasing a sea cow he had seen in a storm
He was following a great shoal of halibut
The other seals had searched all the islands to the east
questions.evidence: he had fallen on the trail of a great shoal of halibut

questions.q: According to the story, why can Sea Cow not speak?
choices: He has six neck bones instead of seven
His split upper lip cannot shape any words
He has forgotten how after years of silence
He only understands the language of the gulls
questions.evidence: He has only six bones in his neck

questions.q: What made Kotick suddenly realize that the strange bowing creatures were Sea Cow?
choices: The old dying seal had described their split lips to him
They waved their flippers to spell out their name in code
He remembered what the Burgomaster gull had screamed at him
He saw them swim into the dark tunnel under the cliff
questions.evidence: he remembered in a flash what the Burgomaster gull had screamed

questions.q: Why did Kotick begin to respect the slow sea cows more as he followed them north?
choices: He saw they were following a warm current on purpose
He learned they could speak many languages after all
They bravely chased away a shark that was hunting him
They shared their seaweed with him when he was hungry
questions.evidence: they were following up a warm current of water, and then he respected them more

questions.q: How did the sea cows reach the hidden beaches?
choices: They waited for a very high tide to carry them over the rocks
They swam through a dark tunnel deep under a cliff
They followed a narrow river inland from the coast
They climbed over a low sand bar at night when no one could see
questions.evidence: plunged into a dark hole at the foot of it, twenty fathoms under the sea

questions.q: The deep water "ran up to the perpendicular cliffs." What are perpendicular cliffs?
choices: Cliffs covered in long grass and moss
Cliffs that go straight up and down
Cliffs made of soft, crumbling sand
Cliffs hidden under the rolling fog
questions.evidence: ran up to the perpendicular cliffs

questions.q: Besides the cliffs, what would keep ships away from the new beaches?
choices: Thick fog that hid the islands from every sailor's view
A line of bars, shoals and rocks out to sea
Strong whirlpools near the mouth of the tunnel
Ice that covered the water for most of the year
questions.evidence: would never let a ship come within six miles of the beach

questions.q: What reason did the young seal give for not following Kotick to the new island?
choices: Kotick had never fought for a nursery the way they had
Kotick was too young to know where seals could live
The new island was too far north for baby seals
Kotick had lied to them about the Sea Cow before
questions.evidence: we've been fighting for our nurseries, and that's a thing you never did

questions.q: Why was Kotick able to beat even the biggest seals on the beach?
choices: His father had secretly trained him to fight every summer
The other seals were too frightened of his white fur
He had never fasted for months, and swimming kept him fit
He attacked them at night while they were all asleep
questions.evidence: Kotick had never fasted for four months as the big seals did every year

questions.q: Kotick "would have scorned to look at or touch one of his wounds." What does "scorned" mean here?
choices: Been too tired and sleepy
Been too proud
Been too afraid of the pain
Been unable to reach
questions.evidence: he would have scorned to look at or touch one of his wounds

questions.q: What is this part of the story mostly about?
choices: Kotick searching for a safe home for seals and leading them there
Kotick learning to fish and hunt from the old walrus Sea Vitch
Kotick racing the other seals to become the leader of the beach
Kotick helping the sea cows escape from the whaling ships
questions.evidence: I only want to show you all a place where you will be safe
